events.name: Bash
events.head: Check branch state and probe header
events.input: $ git log --oneline -3 origin/main && git status --short | head -20 && head -40 app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs && grep -n "gcp_client\|drive_client" cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check ahead count and probe sign-in
events.input: $ git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main && sed -n 40,80p app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs && ls cloud/ | head -30 && grep -n "\"dev\|\"sim\|wrangler dev" cloud/package.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin enter route and notes
events.input: $ grep -rn "admin/enter\|/enter" cloud/src/index.ts | head -8; grep -rln "probe-s1-auto\|admin-enter-url\|/admin/enter" /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/ 2>/dev/null | head; ls workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-258* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read enter routes and admin auth
events.input: $ sed -n 1027,1062p cloud/src/index.ts; grep -n "isAdmin\b.*=\|async function isAdmin" -A10 cloud/src/*.ts | head -25; grep -n "enter\|8792\|sim" /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/onboarding-centre-v2.md | head -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how other probes sign in to admin
events.input: $ grep -rln "admin/enter" app/scripts cloud/scripts --include=*.mjs | head; grep -rn "form: { token\|ADMIN_TOKEN" app/scripts cloud/scripts --include=*.mjs | head -5; ls cloud/.dev.vars; grep -c . cloud/.dev.vars; grep -o "^[A-Z_]*" cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '

events.text: Updating the probe so it signs in to the local admin by POST (the enter route stopped accepting GET), then running it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check running servers and simulator script
events.input: $ lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep -E ":(8790|8792|8796|8797)\b" | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}'; grep -rn "8792" cloud/scripts/*.mjs app/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls cloud/scripts | grep -i sim

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local stack is up
events.input: $ for p in 8790 8791 8792; do printf "$p "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; ps -axo pid,command | grep -E "wrangler|vendor-sim" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-160 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show full args of the stack centre

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply migrations to local dev D1
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4) && echo $DB && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply "$DB" --local 2>&1 | tail -3

events.text: Starting a local centre from this checkout on port 8796 against the simulator, then running the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run local centre on port 8796
events.input: $ npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8796 --ip 127.0.0.1 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8792 --var FUNNEL_PREVIEW_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8794 --var READER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8792/reader/ --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8796 > /tmp/t258-dev.log 2>&1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for centre and run the probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && for i in $(seq 1 30); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://127.0.0.1:8796/admin/enter); [ "$c" = 200 ] && break; /bin/sleep 2; done; echo $c; K=$(grep '^ADMIN_KEY' cloud/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); cd app && node scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:8796/admin/enter?k=$K" 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|PASS)" | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c; node scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:8796/admin/enter?k=$K" > /tmp/t258-probe.txt 2>&1; echo exit $?; grep -c ^PASS /tmp/t258-probe.txt; grep -v ^P

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare running simulator to this checkout's
events.input: $ ps -o command= -p 46012 | cut -c1-250; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && f=$(ls app/scripts/vendor-sim.py cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; grep -n "def main\|argv\|PORT\|port" $f | head -8; grep -c "cloudresourcemanager\|__dns/add" $f /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2/cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Restart local centre against the new simulator
events.input: $ pkill -f "wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8796"; /bin/sleep 2; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && (nohup npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8796 --ip 127.0.0.1 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8797 --var FUNNEL_PREVIEW_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8794 --var READER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8797/reader/ --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8796 > /tmp/t258-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://127.0.0.1:8796/admin/enter); [ "$c" = 200 ] && break; /bin/sleep 2; done; echo centre $c; curl -s -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:

events.text: That was the old centre I stopped on purpose. Running the probe against this checkout's own simulator now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the probe against local centre and simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && K=$(grep '^ADMIN_KEY' cloud/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'); cd app && SIM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8797 node scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:8796/admin/enter?k=$K" > /tmp/t258-probe.txt 2>&1; echo exit $?; grep -c ^PASS /tmp/t258-probe.txt; grep -v ^PASS /tmp/t258-probe.txt | head -20; grep -iE "drive|gcp client|sim_ gcp|button" /tmp/t258-probe.txt
